notice: Bibliographic metadata for the editions the app can read. An edition becomes readable when a matching file exists at assets/data/editions/<slug>.json. No Qur'an text is stored in this file. See DATA_SOURCES.md for how to import a verified edition.

editions.description: Placeholder text used to exercise the reading experience during development. This is not the Qur'an, not a translation of it, and not part of any edition. It exists so the app is runnable straight after checkout, before any dataset has been imported.
The Arabic text of the mushaf in Uthmani orthography, with no translation. For readers who want the Arabic alone.
